title: Vehicle Cabin Multipliers for Moved-Down Cleaning Fees
content:
**Rule.** The fee assessed on a Cleaning and Damage Fees cleaning report that is moved down at review carries a cabin multiplier, read from the reported trip: when the trip's ride option has three seat rows (Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV) and the request was for five or more seats, it is the full-cabin multiplier; when the ride option has three seat rows and the request was for four or fewer seats, or the ride option is a premium two-row option (Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black), it is the partial-cabin multiplier; on any other trip it is one. The flat fee of the level the report is moved to is multiplied by the cabin multiplier, giving the cabin-adjusted fee.

The ride option and the number of seats requested are read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares) for the trip the report is on.

## Schedule of multipliers

| Ride option on the trip | Seats requested | Cabin multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV (three seat rows) | 5 or more | 1.25 (full cabin) |
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV (three seat rows) | 4 or fewer | 1.1 (partial cabin) |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare Black (premium two-row) | any number | 1.1 (partial cabin) |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard or Wayfare Green | any number | 1 |

## The seat boundary on a three-row vehicle

| Seats requested on a Wayfare XL trip | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 4 | 1.1 |
| 5 | 1.25 |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A report moved to a level whose flat fee is $100.00, on a Wayfare Black SUV trip requested for six seats: cabin-adjusted fee $100.00 multiplied by 1.25, that is $125.00.
- The same level on a Wayfare Comfort trip for two seats: $100.00 multiplied by 1.1, that is $110.00.
- The same level on a Wayfare Standard trip: $100.00 multiplied by 1, that is $100.00.
